name: SnowUI
description: SnowUI design tokens (DTCG 2025.10). The single source of truth for src/styles/tokens.generated.css, src/foundations/tokens.generated.ts and src/utils/token-scales.generated.ts: edit these files, then run `bun run tokens`.

foundation.description: Mode-independent tokens: Figma text styles, corner radius and effect styles.

deprecated.description: Old token names, kept as aliases until the next major.

theme.description: The Figma "Colors" collection modes SnowUI-Light and SnowUI-Dark. In CSS: light on :root and [data-theme="light"], dark on [data-theme="dark"] and, without data-theme on <html>, with prefers-color-scheme: dark.

contrast.description: WCAG contrast of the form-control colours (control-border, control-border-strong, placeholder). "standard" (the default) is the Figma look: color.contrast-standard.tokens.json aliases them to the palette, the same in both themes (the Figma kit has no high-contrast mode). "more" adds nothing, so the theme files' values apply: they meet WCAG 2.2 AA (3:1 for boundaries, 4.5:1 for placeholder text). In CSS: "more" with prefers-contrast: more and inside data-contrast="more"; data-contrast="standard" switches back.
